lines: By sharing your details, you agree to receive updates from ACT via email, Whatsapp and mobile.

The ACT Fellowship is an opportunity for early to mid-career professionals to learn what it takes to leverage venture philanthropy for creating social impact at scale.If you’re looking to build your career in social impact, pivot your professional journey towards impact investing or hope to become a social entrepreneur, this program will offer you a platform to learn from leading investors and startup founders to help you gain real-world experience in venture philanthropy.
The ACT Fellowship is an intensive apprenticeship experience that enables you to learn what it means to apply venture capital principles to philanthropy.
As an ACT Fellow, you’ll work with one of our 4 focus areas i.e. ed-tech, public healthcare, climate action or gender inclusivity.

Fellows will work with the ACT team on a wide array of projects including sector research, dealflow sourcing, due diligence, investment pitches, portfolio management, impact assessment, collaborative programs, industry events & partnerships etc.
We’re highly selective about who we invite into the program to ensure that our Fellows have an incredible peer-learning experience as well.
All Fellows will be paid a stipend of Rs. 60,000 per month and each graduating Fellow, on successfully completing the program, will receive an experience letter from ACT.
Ambitious go-getters who can think on their feet, are hungry to learn, enjoy taking on challenges and can work both independently and as part of a team.
Individuals who deeply believe that innovation can accelerate social impact and are abreast of the latest technology trends in the impact space.
Aspiring change-makers who are genuinely interested in the social sector and want to catalyse meaningful change.
Sharp thinkers with a bias for action who are intrigued by the idea of applying venture capital principles to social impact.

The minimum eligibility criteria to apply for the Fellowship is to be a resident Indian citizen, a graduate of any discipline from an accredited university in or outside India, have at least 2 years of full time work experience and based in or willing to relocate to either Bombay, Delhi or Bangalore for the duration of the program.

While we welcome applications from across all professional backgrounds, prior experience as a founder or in strategy consulting / investment banking / impact investing / social sector will be an added advantage.

At a young stage of my journey, I have had the chance to take ownership and lead projects, with constant mentorship and direction from the team. Throughout the program, I had the privilege of immersing myself in ACT's ecosystem of visionary VCs & inspiring social entrepreneurs. This exposure deepened my understanding of critical healthcare issues, broadened my perspective on innovative solutions and ignited a strong sense of responsibility to create lasting impact.

The ACT Fellowship program was an incredible opportunity for me to learn from experts in the social impact space, gain hands-on experience in venture philanthropy, and build my leadership skills. The ACT Fellowship is unlike any other experience in the social impact space! Through ACT, I've learnt that it's okay to fail on our journey to innovate and build for India - but it's not okay to stop trying!

Interested candidates will need to complete and submit an online application form before the stipulated deadline – those shortlisted will be invited for a virtual case interview and then an in-person interview with a member of ACT’s leadership team.
Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis and since we have limited spots, we would recommend you apply as soon as possible.
Selected candidates will undergo reference checks before being matched with an ACT vertical for their Fellowship.
Applications for the 2026-27 cohort will open in June 2026.
